args.title: Corvid Packaging — Freight Pricing This Quarter (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter thread on Q freight pricing.

- Newsletter (newsletter@corvid.example, "Freight pricing this quarter"): flags the quarter's freight pricing update, links the main article at https://blog.corvid.example/2026/freight, and notes that a companion piece is available to subscribers only.

- Main article (blog.corvid.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges have shifted to tracking weekly diesel prices rather than a fixed or monthly basis.

- Subscriber companion (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion, opened with our team subscription code SUB-7948): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least — i.e. a three-carrier split appears to be the cost-minimizing sourcing structure this quarter.

Takeaway for BLUE HERON: soft spot rates plus a three-way carrier split suggest near-term leverage to renegotiate or re-tender freight volume, but fuel surcharges now move weekly with diesel, so any savings estimate needs a diesel-price assumption attached.
